title: Pumpkin Tacos with Lively Slaw
description: A twist on traditional tacos, featuring roasted pumpkin, a lively slaw, and a hint of mexican spice.

ingredients.name: mexican
ingredients.notes: cumin, chili powder, or taco seasoning

instructions: Peel, de-seed, and chop the pumpkin into 1-inch pieces.
Toss pumpkin with 1 tsp of mexican spice and a pinch of salt.
Roast pumpkin in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While pumpkin is roasting, prepare the slaw by combining lively slaw mix, lime juice, and a pinch of salt.
Warm tacos according to package instructions.
Assemble tacos by placing roasted pumpkin, lively slaw, and desired toppings in a warm tortilla.
Serve immediately, garnished with cilantro and a lime wedge if desired.
